title: CIA director Bob Gates's first visit to Moscow and his toast

tellings.quote: And I'll never forget that trip in 19 fall of 1992.

plain: A former CIA officer named Rolf Mowatt-Larssen says he went with CIA director Bob Gates on Gates's first visit to Moscow in the fall of 1992, where Gates made a toast. Mowatt-Larssen tells Michels he was there and will "never forget that trip", which he presents as a moment when the old Cold War rivals sat across the table from each other.
